title: Like Father, Unlike Son/Quotes
summary:
"Freedom is the key to everything, Lok. You can't explore without freedom of movement, you can't solve a puzzle without freedom of thought."
- Eathon Lambert to Lok Lambert in a flashback

"Without order, there is no peace, no security."
- Grier to Dante Vale
full_text:

- Grier to Dante Vale
